avalancheActivity.highlights:
The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field.
The large quantity of fresh snow as well as the wind slabs represent the main danger.
avalancheActivity.comment:
A lot of snow has fallen thus far along the border with France and along the border with Switzerland. The wind will be moderate to strong.
Single backcountry tourers can release avalanches, including medium-sized ones.
Medium-sized natural avalanches are possible on wind-loaded slopes. Above approximately 2500 m they can be released in the new snow and wind slab layers and reach large size in isolated cases, especially on north, northeast and east facing slopes.

snowpackStructure.comment:
Above approximately 2200 m there are 60 to 90 cm of snow, and even as much as 140 cm in some localities, especially above approximately 2600 m.
Over a wide area 30 to 50 cm of snow, and even more in some localities, fell in the last three days above approximately 2000 m.
Today the wind was moderate to strong.
Towards its base, the snowpack is moist, in particular below approximately 2300 m.

tendency.highlights: Over a wide area 30 to 40 cm of snow, and up to 60 cm in some localities, will fall on Sunday above approximately 1600 m. For this reason the danger will increase.

avalancheActivity.highlights:
The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field.
The wind slabs represent the main danger.
avalancheActivity.comment: Thus far the wind has been moderate to strong. In particular adjacent to ridgelines and in gullies and bowls clearly visible wind slabs formed. They can in some places be released by people, especially on north, northeast and east facing slopes.

snowpackStructure.comment:
20 to 30 cm of snow fell in the last three days above approximately 2000 m.
Today the wind was moderate to strong.
At low and intermediate altitudes only a little snow is lying.

tendency.highlights: Over a wide area 15 to 20 cm of snow will fall on Sunday above approximately 1600 m. The avalanche danger will persist.

avalancheActivity.comment: In the last few days the wind was moderate to strong. At high altitude small wind slabs formed.
